# Lumaly Health

Lumaly Health develops OutageGuard, a predictive analytics platform designed to forecast outage risks caused by near-line vegetation for utility companies. By integrating data from camera networks and line inspections, OutageGuard provides actionable insights to prevent wildfire-related outages and improve vegetation management strategies.

Their primary customers are electric utilities focused on outage prevention and wildfire risk mitigation. In pilot deployments with three mid-sized utilities, OutageGuard improved outage prediction accuracy by 25%, reducing unnecessary line inspections by 15%.

Founded in 2021, Lumaly Health has raised $8 million in seed funding led by GreenGrid Ventures. The core team includes experts in machine learning, forestry, and utility operations. Competitors include EmberSight Analytics and Fireline Predict.

Open risks involve data integration challenges with legacy utility systems and scaling the platform across diverse geographic regions.
